title: Inversion for Emphasis
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! La Inversión (Inversion for Emphasis) es una de las estructuras más avanzadas y elegantes del inglés. Usar frases como 'Never have I seen...' o 'Not only did we win...' te da una presencia escénica y una fuerza retórica propia de grandes líderes y oradores.

parts.visual:
En inglés muy formal o dramático (discursos, escritura persuasiva), podemos poner una palabra negativa o restrictiva al PRINCIPIO de la oración para dar énfasis. Al hacerlo, debemos invertir el sujeto y el verbo auxiliar (como si fuera una pregunta). 

1. Never / Rarely / Seldom (Nunca / Rara vez): 
Normal: We have never faced such a crisis. 
Inversión: NEVER HAVE WE faced such a crisis. (Énfasis fuerte). 
Normal: They rarely complain. 
Inversión: RARELY DO THEY complain. (Usamos DO porque no hay auxiliar en la original).
parts.audio: In highly formal or dramatic English, such as in public speaking or persuasive writing, we can put a negative or restrictive word at the BEGINNING of the sentence for emphasis. When we do this, we must invert the subject and the auxiliary verb, just like in a question. Number 1: Never, Rarely, or Seldom. Normal sentence: We have never faced such a crisis. Inverted for emphasis: NEVER HAVE WE faced such a crisis. Normal: They rarely complain. Inverted: RARELY DO THEY complain. Notice we use 'do' because the original sentence didn't have an auxiliary verb.

parts.visual:
2. Not only... but also (No solo... sino también): 
Normal: We achieved the target and we exceeded it. 
Inversión: NOT ONLY DID WE achieve the target, but we also exceeded it. 

3. Under no circumstances / On no account (Bajo ninguna circunstancia): 
Normal: You should not share this information under any circumstances. 
Inversión: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU share this information. 

4. Little (Poco / No saber algo): 
Normal: He little knew that the company was bankrupt. 
Inversión: LITTLE DID HE KNOW that the company was bankrupt.
parts.audio: Number 2: Not only... but also. Normal: We achieved the target and we exceeded it. Inverted: NOT ONLY DID WE achieve the target, but we also exceeded it. Number 3: Under no circumstances or On no account. Normal: You should not share this information under any circumstances. Inverted: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU share this information. Number 4: Little, meaning not knowing something. Normal: He little knew that the company was bankrupt. Inverted: LITTLE DID HE KNOW that the company was bankrupt.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de inversión.

questions.question: Normal: I have never seen such a disaster. -> Never ____ such a disaster.
questions.explanation: Inversión de auxiliar y sujeto: have I.

questions.question: Normal: We rarely lose a client. -> Rarely ____ a client.
questions.explanation: Present simple sin auxiliar, se usa DO: do we lose.

questions.question: Normal: We did not only meet the deadline, but we also saved money. -> Not only ____ the deadline, but we also saved money.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple sin auxiliar, se usa DID: did we meet.

questions.question: Normal: You must not open this file under any circumstances. -> Under no circumstances ____ this file.
questions.explanation: Inversión con modal: must you open.

questions.question: Normal: They little realized the danger they were in. -> Little ____ the danger they were in.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple (realized), requiere auxiliar DID: did they realize.

questions.question: Normal: I had seldom felt so nervous before a presentation. -> Seldom ____ so nervous before a presentation.
questions.explanation: Inversión con Past Perfect: had I felt.

questions.question: Normal: I had no sooner sat down than the phone rang. -> No sooner ____ down than the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Estructura clásica: No sooner had I sat down than...

questions.question: Normal: We will not accept their offer on any account. -> On no account ____ their offer.
questions.explanation: Inversión con futuro: will we accept.

questions.question: Normal: I didn't say a word until she finished speaking. -> Not a word ____ until she finished speaking.
questions.explanation: Inversión de pasado con did: did I say.

questions.question: Normal: She is not only brilliant, but she is also hardworking. -> Not only ____ brilliant, but she is also hardworking.
questions.explanation: Inversión con el verbo to be: is she.

questions.question: Normal: They had hardly started the meeting when the fire alarm went off. -> Hardly ____ the meeting when the fire alarm went off.
questions.explanation: Hardly + had + sujeto + participio: had they started.

questions.question: Normal: You can enter the server room only if you have clearance. -> Only if you have clearance ____ the server room.
questions.explanation: Con 'Only if', la inversión ocurre en la cláusula principal: can you enter.

questions.question: Normal: We did not realize the scale of the problem until later. -> Not until later ____ the scale of the problem.
questions.explanation: Not until later + inversión: did we realize.

questions.question: Normal: I have rarely heard such a persuasive argument. -> Rarely ____ such a persuasive argument.
questions.explanation: Inversión de Present Perfect: have I heard.

questions.question: Normal: He understood little about the new software. -> Little ____ about the new software.
questions.explanation: Little (al principio de frase) requiere inversión con did: did he understand.

questions.question: Normal: The CEO had barely finished speaking when journalists started shouting. -> Barely ____ finished speaking when journalists started shouting.
questions.explanation: Barely + had + sujeto: had the CEO.

questions.question: Normal: The company will in no way accept liability. -> In no way ____ accept liability.
questions.explanation: In no way + auxiliar: will the company.

questions.question: Normal: They didn't know that their emails were being monitored. -> Little ____ that their emails were being monitored.
questions.explanation: Little did they know (clásico modismo de suspenso).

questions.question: Normal: I haven't seen such a poorly managed project anywhere. -> Nowhere ____ such a poorly managed project.
questions.explanation: Nowhere + inversión: have I seen.

questions.question: Normal: You shouldn't sign the contract under any circumstances. -> Under no circumstances ____ the contract.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances should you sign.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra que falta para completar la inversión.

questions.question: Never ____ I seen such a thing. (have/has)
questions.explanation: have.

questions.question: Rarely ____ they complain. (do/does/did)
questions.explanation: do.

questions.question: Not only ____ we win, but we also broke records. (did/do)
questions.explanation: did.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ____ you open this. (should/must)
questions.explanation: must (o should, asume must por contexto si es obligación fuerte, aceptaré should/must, pero la respuesta es should o must).

questions.question: Little ____ he know the truth. (did/does - pasado)
questions.explanation: did.

questions.question: No sooner ____ I sat down than the phone rang. (had/have)
questions.explanation: had.

questions.question: On no account ____ we accept this. (will/would - futuro)
questions.explanation: will.

questions.question: Hardly ____ they started when it rained. (had/have)
questions.explanation: had.

questions.question: Not until later ____ we realize. (did/do)
questions.explanation: did.

questions.question: In no way ____ the company responsible. (is/are)
questions.explanation: is (is the company).

pairs.target: No fue hasta más tarde que nos dimos cuenta
